purpose: Create one main ODIN page with left-side integrated capabilities menu and V04 planning tracker before Real Core implementation.

phases.name: Foundation Lock
phases.what: Fix 199D as ACTIVE BASE, archive 200D–230D as experimental reference, stop meta-expansion.
phases.why: Reduce entropy, keep clean foundation, prevent endless QA/seal layering.

phases.name: Main Control Hub Cleanup
phases.what: Create one main page, left menu of integrated capabilities, V04 plan tracker.
phases.why: User must see the system, the plan, and progress from one place.
phases.result: Controlled ODIN main hub before Real Core work.

phases.name: Real State Engine
phases.what: Create real active state, package registry, module registry, rollback points.
phases.why: ODIN must know its current state before executing real actions.

phases.name: Real Execution Engine
phases.what: Action Request → Validation → Execution → Result → Log → State Update.
phases.why: Move from demo buttons to real system actions.

phases.name: Persistence Layer
phases.what: Local JSON, IndexedDB, file persistence, later Git/GitHub persistence.
phases.why: State must survive reloads and become restorable.

phases.name: Live UI State Graph
phases.what: Live state viewer, execution graph, logs, health monitor, module manager.
phases.why: User must see real system state and actions.

phases.name: Recovery Replay Engine
phases.what: Snapshots, replay, rollback, restore, corruption detection.
phases.why: Recovery must become real, not conceptual.

phases.name: Autonomous Loop
phases.what: Observers, watchdogs, schedulers, background tasks, integrity monitors.
phases.why: ODIN should begin operating autonomously within defined limits.

phases.name: Real Product System
phases.what: Integrate Deutsch Trainer, Lesson Factory, QA, Export, Workflow, Runtime.
phases.why: Turn ODIN into productive platform, not only system architecture.

nextStep: Prepare V04.0 — Real State Engine Bootstrap.
